objective: Implement A10 v1 Opportunity & Audience Intelligence M01-M05: offline-first, provider-neutral human-provided signal intake, comparable trend hypotheses, evidence-aware audience insight, transparent creative opportunities, and non-breaking A03 ContentBrief bridge.
source_decision: Human ChatGPT 2026-10-29: @AI Commerce Engineering Workflow thực hiện theo deep research A10 v1 — Cơ hội & Thông minh Khán giả (Offline-First, Provider-Neutral).
research_ref: ChatGPT Deep Research A10 v1 report 2026-10-29: TrendSignal, TrendSeries, AudienceProfile, OpportunityProposal, ContentBrief. Research is design input, not evidence of implemented provider access or permission.
scope_in: M01 Trend Intake: explicit human-supplied CSV/UTF-8-BOM and canonical JSON profiles for signal snapshots (topic, source type, locale, event/window/collected_at, unit/denominator/query-context, access/rights, raw evidence hash). Immutable raw bytes and append-only SQLite journal; no fabricated native provider CSV templates.

M02 Trend Tracking: compare only identical metric/units/baselines/query-normalization/geo/locale/window; distinguish single snapshot vs trend, sparse and stale history, topic vs creative-format trends and counterevidence. Transparent, configurable deterministic heuristic; never assert viral certainty or causal lift.

M03 Audience Insights: evidence-linked qualitative audience jobs-to-be-done, friction, content context, contradictions and inferred hypotheses, caller-observed provenance; avoid storing individual PII or deriving demographic claims without evidence.

M04 Opportunities: source-linked niche/content-only hypotheses, alternatives, uncertainty and explicit reasons/counterevidence, optional prioritization as advisory ranking not calibrated probability; no purchase/post decisions.

M05 Opportunity-to-Creative: map immutable source refs to existing A03 ContentBrief.v0.1 using intake_brief()/validate_record() and CreativeStore optional consumer; preserve nullable product_ref/CTA/format and Human freeform/override; deterministic offline CLI and synthetic demo.
Minimal deterministic unit/integration tests, cross-platform CI and A03/A06/A08/A09 regressions on exact integrated candidate; candidate-only, no automatic main merge.
scope_out: Any live provider API, OAuth, credentials, access entitlement claims, headless scraping or automatic social publishing; no account or campaign spend.
Assuming Google Trends index is absolute demand, averaging incomparable provider metrics, inventing audience demographics from sparse notes, or ranking-as-probability/viral predictions.
Changing A03 ContentBrief.v0.1, existing A09 ledger semantics/contracts, A07/A08 evidence, or external accounts without separate authorization.
A11 learning dashboard/performance evaluation, affiliate placements/revenue/settlement, warehouse/multi-user service, mandatory LLM, UI app, model API spend.
Mandatory gating of freeform creative on A10 signal availability; mandatory format/product/CTA/storyboard, creative review, or Human approval for mere idea generation.
EF01/EF02 infrastructure changes, AIOS-Renew runtime or legacy task conventions.

design_decisions.canonical_a03_contract: src/ai_commerce/contracts/schemas/ContentBrief.v0.1.schema.json: required brief_id/objective, optional prompt/audience/product_ref nullable/cta nullable/media_hint nullable/source_refs; additionalProperties=true. Reuse src/ai_commerce/creative/briefs.py intake_brief; never replace schema.
design_decisions.canonical_a09_boundary: A09 is an audience performance analytics importer, not trend-intelligence storage. A10 uses independent SQLite evidence and may read A09 by explicit provenance only if identity/window/metric match; never infer provider verification.
design_decisions.signal_state: User-supplied observation != externally verified fact. Separate OBSERVED_USER_SUPPLIED / INFERRED / UNKNOWN; source right ACCESS_UNKNOWN is not permission, zero distinct from NOT_AVAILABLE.
design_decisions.metric_scope: Keep absolute count, index/relative normalized unit, rate, denominator and query scale separate. Never blend normalized Google Trends snapshots from different query contexts by arithmetic.
design_decisions.identity: Content-addressed SHA256 for raw, context and record, stable import IDs bound to locale/source/metric/window/mapping, immutable correction/reprocess lineage.
design_decisions.trend_default: At least three comparable observed points across distinct timestamps for a direction hypothesis; otherwise INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY, configurable and explicit; no automatic conclusion from one snapshot.
design_decisions.scope_concurrency: M01 first; M02 and M03 after M01 independently in non-overlapping component paths; M04 after M02 and M03; M05 after M04. max_parallel=2 only when two READY actions.

acceptance: AC01 exact source raw bytes and hashes round-trip; immutable append-only import ledger, idempotent same context and separate corrections, no silent cross-account/locale merging.

AC02 manual CSV BOM/JSON with explicit column mapping and bounded validation of malformed encoding, timezones, numeric values, missing fields, duplicates and file/path limits; fully atomic import; no false native export claims.
AC03 rate/count/index/denominator/window/locale/geo/query context cannot be compared if incompatible; zero not NULL and single snapshot not GROWING TREND.
AC04 transparent M02 trend/hypothesis output: INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY, stale and contradictory evidence distinct from actual direction; no false confidence or unsupported causal claims.
AC05 M03 audience insight stores observed vs inferred and counterevidence with evidence refs, does not accidentally store PII, remains optional for freeform creative.
AC06 M04 proposals trace to observed inputs and limitations; cannot claim validated demand, virality, provider rights or spend authority; empty/missing inputs handled honestly.
AC07 M05 produces a ContentBrief that passes the actual A03 schema/intake, keeps product_ref and CTA nullable, no required media format or concept quota; original Human text preserved and editable.
AC08 deterministic source→trend/insight→proposal→brief end-to-end synthetic offline demo with provenance, realistic negative cases and no external effects.
AC09 targeted and full applicable project tests with actual Windows and Ubuntu CI results; not only wrapper green. Check candidate fan-in conflict and worktree changes.
AC10 A10 remains suggestion-only and does not bypass A07/A08/A09 evidence; no network/OAuth/scraping/real publish and no implicit main merge.
risk_notes: Research illustrative ContentBrief fields do NOT equal the canonical A03 ContentBrief.v0.1; implementation must use real schema not invent a replacement.
Research illustrative AnalyticsImport record is A09's different meaning; A10 must use its own SignalImport ledger and source/status semantics.
Deep Research's platform-trend sources do not prove provider export schemas, rights, or live API access; explicit manual source only for v1.
Concurrent M02/M03 candidate trees must not edit same files and must integrate through actual EF02 dependency composition; verify complete fan-in and tests.
